{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''TT4472''''' was one of three [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]s employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], along with a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Hart]]'', to extract [[Alliance Military/Legends|officers]] from the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Anvil (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Anvil'']] which had been severely [[Defense of the Anvil|damaged]] and needed to be abandoned. 3 [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], one of which piloted by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]], provided support and cover for the convoy of ships to escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]]. Farlander then scuttled the frigate to prevent its capture.
